exposure: electronic job aid-supported nutrition counselling and practical demonstration
cohort: Participants were pregnant women randomized into five study arms in rural Bangladesh, with mother-child dyads followed until 2 years of age.
finding: Electronic job aid-supported nutrition counselling significantly reduced prelacteal feeds and increased exclusive breastfeeding rates at 4 and 5 months of age compared to usual practice.
mod_finding: No difference in exclusive breastfeeding was observed between caesarean and vaginal births.
